source.content: @isTest private class CoreRuntimeContextIndustriesContextLocalEvidenceTest { @isTest static void mapPassthroughMethodsReturnDeterministicMaps() { Context.IndustriesContext ctx = new Context.IndustriesContext(); Map<String,Object> input = new Map<String,Object>{'recordId' => '001000000000001'}; System.assertNotEquals(null, ctx.addRecordsToContext(input)); System.assertNotEquals(null, ctx.buildContext(input)); System.assertNotEquals(null, ctx.filteringContext(input)); System.assertNotEquals(null, ctx.getContext(input)); System.assertNotEquals(null, ctx.getContextTranslation(input)); System.assertNotEquals(null, ctx.leanerQueryTags(input)); System.assertNotEquals(null, ctx.persistContext(input)); System.assertNotEquals(null, ctx.queryContextRecordsAndChildren(input)); System.assertNotEquals(null, ctx.queryRecordStatus(input)); System.assertNotEquals(null, ctx.queryTags(input)); System.assertNotEquals(null, ctx.updateContextAttributes(input)); } }
